$comment: Config for the Atoll issue watcher (scripts/atoll-watch.mjs). Edit projects/statuses/window here; no secrets live in this file.
$localRepoPathNote: localRepoPath is the MAIN repo checkout for this project on THIS machine (not a worktree) — /workflow's auto-launch cd's here first, then creates a new branch+worktree per spec. Update this on each machine (Windows path here; use the macOS clone path on the Mac).

projects.name: VMG Tools Platform
projects.$supportsPickupEntryNote: true = this repo's own .claude/commands/workflow.md has the 'pickup <ID>' entry mode (added for this automation) — auto-launch uses it directly. false = fall back to a plain direct-request prompt built from the issue title, since coal's /workflow is a separate, older copy we don't modify.

projects.name: COAL: Creative Opportunity Analyzer Lab
projects.$baseBranchNote: coal branches/worktrees are cut from staging, NOT main (GitHub default is main, but staging is the working base) — every new worktree must start from staging, and PRs target staging.

notify.$statusNote: Only issues in these statuses trigger a ping. Empty array = any non-terminal status.
notify.$skipNote: true = don't ping issues already assigned to you (already claimed). Reymond-assigned issues are still pinged unless you add exclude rules.

pickup.$keywordNote: A Telegram reply of 'pickup VTP-1234' assigns that issue to you (self) and confirms. Case-insensitive.
pickup.$approveNote: A Telegram reply of 'approve VTP-1234' posts a human-approval comment so a parked card (waiting for human approval) resumes on the next /workflow loop cycle.

autoLaunch.$note: On a successful pickup claim: silently checkout+pull the project's baseBranch in its localRepoPath (coal vs tool-portal, resolved by identifier prefix), then open a NEW TERMINAL window running `claude "<prompt>"` directly (fully hands-free — the prompt is a real CLI argument, not a paste). Deliberately NOT the Desktop app: it shares one window across tabs with no way to target a specific tab, and its claude://code/new deep link has no message parameter (verified against the app's own source) — tried and confirmed unreliable live (keystroke injection can land in the wrong already-open tab). Windows-only today; set enabled:false to fall back to notify-only (Telegram just says 'claimed, open Claude Code yourself').
